storeInfo.name: Urban Lodge Brewing
storeInfo.tagline: Craft beer, artisan kitchen, and community gathering in Manchester, CT.

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Pretzels artesanales horneados al horno, servidos con mostaza de cerveza artesanal y queso cheddar fundido.
products.descriptionEn: Bavarian style warm pretzels served with craft beer mustard and warm cheddar cheese dip.

products.nameEs: Alitas Ahumadas de la Selva Negra
products.descriptionEs: Alitas de pollo ahumadas lentamente en casa, glaseadas con salsa BBQ de stout y acompañadas de aderezo ranch.
products.descriptionEn: Slow-smoked house chicken wings tossed in our signature stout BBQ glaze, served with ranch dressing.

products.descriptionEs: Carne de res jugosa de granja local, queso cheddar maduro, tocino crujiente, cebollas caramelizadas y salsa especial en pan brioche.
products.descriptionEn: Local farm-raised beef patty, aged cheddar, crispy bacon, caramelized onions, and house special sauce on a brioche bun.

products.nameEs: Sándwich de Pollo Crujiente al Estilo Lodge
products.descriptionEs: Pechuga de pollo empanizada crujiente, lechuga fresca, pepinillos caseros y mayonesa picante de chipotle.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy fried chicken breast, fresh lettuce, house pickles, and zesty chipotle mayo on a toasted roll.

products.nameEs: Tacos de Cerdo Desmenuzado con IPA
products.descriptionEs: Cerdo desmenuzado cocinado a fuego lento con nuestra IPA insignia, ensalada de repollo crujiente y crema de cilantro.
products.descriptionEn: Slow-braised pulled pork cooked with our flagship IPA, crunchy coleslaw, and fresh cilantro crema in warm tortillas.

products.descriptionEs: Mix de lechugas frescas, manzanas crujientes locales, nueces tostadas, queso de cabra desmenuzado y vinagreta de sidra de manzana.
products.descriptionEn: Mixed greens, local crisp apples, toasted walnuts, crumbled goat cheese, and house apple cider vinaigrette.

products.nameEs: Cerveza Stowe Away New England IPA
products.descriptionEn: Our flagship New England IPA, all-Citra dry-hopped with juicy tropical fruit notes. 6.3% ABV.
A refreshing sour with a finely tuned balance of sweet and tart. Raspberry or Pineapple-Mango. 4.5% ABV.
Bellis Small Batch Bourbon, brown sugar, and house blend bitters served over a large ice cube.
Waypoint Citrus Vodka, fresh lemon, Fruitful Blueberry Liqueur, and club soda.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con opciones vegetarianas y sin gluten claramente marcadas en nuestro menú. Pregunte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer clearly marked vegetarian and gluten-free options. Please ask your server for details.

faqs.qEs: ¿Se permiten niños y mascotas en el taproom?
faqs.qEn: Are children and pets allowed in the taproom?
faqs.aEs: ¡Las familias son el núcleo de Urban Lodge! Los niños son bienvenidos y las mascotas educadas son bienvenidas en nuestra zona exterior.
faqs.aEn: Family is at the core of Urban Lodge! Children are welcome, and well-behaved dogs are welcome in our outdoor patio areas.

faqs.aEs: Sí, vendemos latas de 4 packs y opciones frescas directo de nuestras llaves para llevar a casa.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer 4-pack cans and fresh crowlers straight from our taps to take home.
